name: Charlemagne
summary: Canadian 4-player partnership trick-taking game derived from Euchre with Jokers as top trumps and bid contracts
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships opposite each other use 34 cards: A-7 in all suits plus two ranked Jokers (uncoloured higher). Trump ranking: high Joker, low Joker, Jack of trump (Big Jack), Jack of same colour (Little Jack), A K Q 10 9 8 7. Other suits similar but same-colour suit lacks its Jack. Deal 8 cards each plus 2-card kitty. One round clockwise bidding: 5-8 = bidder's team must win that many tricks; Mulot = bidder alone loses all tricks; Charlemagne = bidder alone wins all with kitty plus one hidden card from partner; Gros versions = cards exposed or kitty-or-card only. Winning number bidder takes kitty, discards to 8, names trump and leads. Must follow suit if able; Little Jack and Jokers count as trump; highest trump wins else highest of led suit. In Mulot no trump except Jokers must be played when cannot follow; led Joker forces other Joker. Scoring: number bids score face value, Mulot 15/7, Charlemagne 16/8, Gros Mulot 30/15, Gros Charlemagne 32/16. Failing transfers points to opponents. First to 32 wins.
